versioning: patch release: compatible defaults and fixes; no new scheduling input, no schema change, no new external side effect
node_config: config/zenobia-node.json: the live 0.7.0 node.json plus memory.auto_default true and the spheral alias default_mem "auto"
features: CRITICAL: job units never make the user manager spawn into their cgroup after start (no ExecStopPost/ExecStartPost/ExecStop; the worker records a killed job from the unit's Result/MemoryPeak/CPUUsageNSec, units not collected and reset-failed after recording), OOMPolicy=stop (memory.oom.group 0), leftover MPI /dev/shm segments removed after a job; real-OOM tests opt-in and refused on zenobia; the install removes the interim simq-job-.service.d OOMPolicy drop-in

head-of-line fix: the planner accounts actual memory (MemAvailable - margin - young jobs' unallocated requests; a running job's end frees what it uses), so reservations and backfill include memory; jobs above what the node can ever admit (best queue-idle MemAvailable over the last hour, or memory_schedulable, minus the margin) are parked with a reason and hold no reservation; submit warns
memory.auto_default: a job without --mem gets --mem auto when its name (family) has a recorded peak, else the default; explicit --mem wins
robust load-sensitive tests (borrow placement, CPU priority best of three windows, ensemble launch-gate tails); run-tests.py isolates XDG_STATE_HOME and SIMQUEUE_STATE_DIR
secret values in the four older upgrade backups redacted in place (7, 60, 205, 705 job rows)
documented: replays of idempotency keys first submitted under 0.6.x are refused
run-tests.py removes inherited SIMQUEUE_* variables (in-job runs pointed tests at the live node.json: 43 failures in the first official run, job 1057)
